preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 9 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 9 and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each employee's input line contains two integers ai and bi where 1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ 9 and ai ≠ bi, representing their current floor and destination floor, respectively.
The first line is n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000), the number of employees, followed by n lines of employee data.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal time in seconds required to deliver all employees to their destinations.

The output is the minimal possible time, where min_possible_time is the smallest integer such that all employees can be transported to their destinations following the elevator rules (order of entry, capacity, and movement time).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 9 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 9 and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The input constraints are preserved in the calculation of min_possible_time.
